claim: Helion delivers at least 50MW of fusion electricity to Microsoft
caveat: A signed power purchase agreement rather than a stated intention, which is the most binding form any claim here takes. If contractual commitment shortens the correction, this is where that should show.

decision.decision: Deliver 50MW of fusion electricity under a power purchase agreement

requirements.text: At least 50MW must be delivered to the grid by 2028
Net electricity from fusion must be produced at all first

steps.name: Demonstrate net electricity on a prototype
Build the plant and interconnect it
